title: Raku Class October 4
source_quote: Bad Weather- Postponed Raku Class October 4th
evidence_sentence: The page lists a raku class on October 4 with glazing from 10-11:30 am and firing from 12:30-3 pm.
evidence_quote: Firing will start at 12:30 pm to 3pm October 4th - Sunday
summary: A single-session public raku class on October 4, 2026 where you glaze two pre-made forms and attend the firing. Limited to 10 students; $110.
how_to_join: Sign up on the class booking registration on the home page
